source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 4 (PDF 94-129), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Molecular Biology (chapter banner printed as 'Biomolecules')) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define biochemistry. Why is its knowledge helpful in biology?
(Biochemistry ki definition likhein. Biology mein is ka ilm kyun madadgaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Biochemistry jaandaaron mein chemical ajza aur chemical amal ka mutaala hai. Jaandaaron ki har banawat biochemical hai aur har kaam biochemical amal se hota hai, is liye yeh anatomy aur physiology samajhne mein madad deti hai (jaise photosynthesis, respiration, digestion, contraction).

book_ref.quote: Biochemistry is the study of chemical components and chemical processes

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between anabolism and catabolism.
(Anabolism aur catabolism mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono metabolism (cell ke tamam chemical reactions) ki do qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: In anabolism, simpler substances are combined to form complex substances

blocks.prompt:
3 What are organic molecules? Name the four important organic molecules of living organisms.
(Organic molecules kya hain? Jaandaaron ke chaar ahem organic molecules ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cells ke banaye hue carbon wale molecules organic molecules hain; yeh qudrati taur par sirf jaandaaron ya un ki paidawar aur baqiyat mein milte hain. Chaar ahem: carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids (dry mass ka 93%).

book_ref.quote: The molecules synthesized by cells and containing carbon are known as organic molecules

blocks.prompt:
4 What are functional groups? Give examples.
(Functional groups kya hain? Misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Organic molecules ke carbon core se atoms ke khaas groups jure hote hain; yeh functional groups hain, jaise OH, CO, COOH, NH₂. Zyada tar biochemical reactions functional group ko aik molecule se doosre mein le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: These groups are called functional groups for example OH, CO, COOH, NH₂ etc.

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between a monomer and a polymer, with an example.
(Monomer aur polymer mein misaal ke saath farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se macromolecules saada monomers ke polymers hain.

book_ref.quote: A polymer is a molecule consisting of many identical molecular units, called monomers

rows: Bohat se aik jaise units ka molecule

blocks.prompt:
6 Why is carbon the basic element of organic molecules? Give two of its important bonds.
(Carbon organic molecules ka bunyaadi element kyun hai? Is ke do ahem bonds batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbon tetravalent (chaar bond banane wala) hai aur H, O, N, P aur S se milta hai. Is ka C-H bond chemical energy ka zariya hai; glycosidic linkages mein C-O jor pecheeda carbohydrates ko mazboot karta hai (aur peptide bond mein C-N proteins banata hai).

book_ref.quote: Carbon combines with nitrogen in amino acid linkages to form peptide bonds

blocks.prompt:
7 Differentiate between a covalent bond and an ionic bond.
(Covalent bond aur ionic bond mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono atoms ko molecules mein jorne wale bonds hain.

book_ref.quote: The electrostatic attraction between these oppositely charged ions forms the ionic bond

rows: Do atoms electrons share karte hain
Aik atom electron deta aur doosra leta hai
Cation aur anion bante hain; electrostatic kashish unhein jorti hai
Aksar organic molecules mein (proteins, nucleic acids)
Zyada tar inorganic molecules mein (sodium chloride)

blocks.prompt:
8 What is a hydrogen bond? Give its importance.
(Hydrogen bond kya hai? Is ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bond hydrogen atom aur electronegative atom (jaise oxygen ya nitrogen) ke darmiyan kamzor kashish hai. Yeh proteins aur nucleic acids ki banawat qaim rakhta hai aur DNA replication jaise amal mein ahem hai.

book_ref.quote: These bonds are important in maintaining the structure of large molecules like proteins and nucleic acids

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between hydrophobic and hydrophilic interactions.
(Hydrophobic aur hydrophilic interactions mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono molecules aur paani ke darmiyan interactions hain.

book_ref.quote: Nonpolar molecules tend to cluster together in aqueous environments to minimize contact with water molecules

rows: Nonpolar molecules paani se bachne ke liye ikatthe ho jate hain
Polar molecules paani ke molecules se interact karte hain
Protein folding aur lipid bilayer banne ke liye zaroori
Polar aur ionic compounds hal karne ke liye zaroori; cells mein ghiza ki muntaqili aur reactions mein madad

blocks.prompt:
10 Why is condensation also called dehydration synthesis?
(Condensation ko dehydration synthesis kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Condensation mein aik monomer se -OH aur doosre se -H hat-ta hai. OH aur H ka hatna paani ka nikalna (dehydration) hai aur saath bara molecule banta hai (synthesis), jaise do glucose se maltose.

book_ref.quote: It is also known as dehydration synthesis because the removal of OH and H groups means the removal of a water molecule

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between dehydration synthesis and hydrolysis.
(Dehydration synthesis aur hydrolysis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydrolysis dehydration synthesis ka ulat hai.

book_ref.quote: Hydrolysis is a chemical process in which macromolecule (polymer) is broken down into smaller fragments

rows: Monomers jur kar polymer banate hain
Polymer chhote tukron mein toot-ta hai
Paani ka molecule shamil hota hai
Cells ko energy deni parti hai
Energy ke liye zaroori chhote molecules milte hain

blocks.prompt:
12 Why is hydrolysis important for living organisms?
(Hydrolysis jaandaaron ke liye kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrolysis macromolecules ko chhote molecules mein torti hai. Yeh digestion aur cellular respiration mein zaroori hai jahan energy ke liye chhote molecules chahiye.

book_ref.quote: This breakdown of macromolecules is essential in various biological processes

blocks.prompt:
13 How does the amount of water vary in organisms and tissues? Give examples.
(Jaandaaron aur tissues mein paani ki miqdaar kaise badalti hai? Misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Paani tamam jaandaaron mein sab se zyada compound hai; mukhtalif jaandaaron mein 65 se 89 feesad. Kai-cell jaandaaron mein tissue ke hisaab se badalta hai: haddi ke cells mein taqreeban 20 feesad aur dimagh ke cells mein 85 feesad.

book_ref.quote: In multicellular organisms, its concentration varies from tissue to tissue

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is a water molecule called polar?
(Paani ke molecule ko polar kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ke molecule ke do alag sire hain jin par juzvi charge hai: hydrogen juzvi positive aur oxygen juzvi negative hai. Aise siron wale molecules polar kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: Such molecules are called polar molecules

blocks.prompt:
15 How are hydrogen bonds formed among water molecules?
(Paani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik paani ke molecule ka juzvi negative sira (oxygen) doosre molecule ke juzvi positive sire (hydrogen) ki taraf khinchta hai. Yeh kamzor kashish hydrogen bond hai; paani in bonds ka jaal banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Many of the properties of water are due to hydrogen bonds in water

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between hydrophilic and hydrophobic molecules.
(Hydrophilic aur hydrophobic molecules mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Molecules paani mein mukhtalif rawayya rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Polar molecules such as salts, sugars, and amino acids dissolve readily in water

blocks.prompt:
17 Why does water provide a medium for metabolism?
(Paani metabolism ke liye medium kyun faraham karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Charged ya polar molecules (Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ jaise ions, ya glucose) paani mein hal hote hain. Mehlool mein ions aur molecules aapas mein asaani se react karte hain, is liye paani cells ke chemical reactions ka medium hai.

book_ref.quote: So, water provides a medium for metabolism (chemical reactions in cells)

blocks.prompt:
18 How does cohesion help water rise in plants?
(Cohesion paudon mein paani charhane mein kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Patte se paani ki bukhaarat xylem vessels ke paani par khinchao dalti hai. Cohesion (paani ke molecules ki aapas mein kashish) ki wajah se yeh khinchao xylem se jaron tak pohanchta hai aur paani kashish-e-saql ke khilaf charhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Plants depend on cohesion among water molecules for the transport of water and nutrients from roots to leaves

blocks.prompt:
19 What gives water high surface tension? Give one example of it.
(Paani ko zyada surface tension kis se milti hai? Is ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds paani ko zyada surface tension dete hain; paani aisa lagta hai jaise is par na-nazar jhilli ho. Misaal: keera water-strider satah toray baghair paani par chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Water behaves as if it were coated with some invisible film

blocks.prompt:
20 Define specific heat capacity. How does it make water a temperature stabilizer?
(Specific heat capacity ki definition likhein. Yeh paani ko temperature stabilizer kaise banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Specific heat capacity woh calories hain jo 1 g substance ka temperature 15 °C se 16 °C karne ke liye chahiye. Paani ki zyada hai (4.184 J), is liye yeh dheere garam hota hai aur thandi jagah der tak temperature rakhta hai; yeh jaandaaron ke andar aur bahar ka temperature mustaqil rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Specific heat capacity is defined as the number of calories

blocks.prompt:
21 Why does water absorb much heat with little rise in its temperature?
(Paani bohat heat jazb kar ke bhi apna temperature kam kyun barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ki jazb ki hui zyada tar heat molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torne mein lagti hai. Bonds tootne ke baad hi molecules azadi se harkat karte hain aur temperature barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to this breakage of hydrogen bonds, individual water molecules start moving more freely

blocks.prompt:
22 Define heat of vaporization. How does it benefit organisms?
(Heat of vaporization ki definition likhein. Yeh jaandaaron ko kya faida deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heat of vaporization woh heat hai jo maae ko gas banane ke liye chahiye; paani ki 574 Kcal/kg hai. Yeh transpiration aur paseene par paudon aur janwaron ko thanda karti hai (har gram bukhaarat 574 calories nikalta hai) aur zameen ka temperature mo'tadil rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: It also provides cooling effects to plants and animals when they transpire and perspire

blocks.prompt:
23 What is hydrophobic exclusion? Give its importance.
(Hydrophobic exclusion kya hai? Is ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Non-polar molecules hal nahi hote kyun ke paani un se hydrogen bonds nahi banata; paani unhein bahar karta hai aur woh aapas mein hydrophobic jor banate hain. Lipids paani se alag ho kar mazboot jurte hain aur cell membranes qaim rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: The insoluble molecules make hydrophobic associations with one another

blocks.prompt:
24 What is ionization of water? Why is it important?
(Paani ki ionization kya hai? Yeh kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ke molecule ke covalent bonds tootne par yeh H⁺ aur OH⁻ mein ionize hota hai (ulat sakne wala; 25 °C par 550 million mein se aik, har ion 10⁻⁷ moles/litre). H⁺ aur OH⁻ hydrolysis jaise reactions mein hisse lete hain aur in ki nisbat pH tay karti hai jo enzymes par asar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: When the covalent bonds among the atoms of water molecule break, water is ionized

blocks.prompt:
25 How do acids and bases change the medium of water?
(Acids aur bases paani ke medium ko kaise badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Acids OH⁻ ions se jur kar medium mein H⁺ chhorte hain aur use acidic banate hain. Bases H⁺ ions se jur kar OH⁻ chhorte hain aur medium basic banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Similarly bases combine with H⁺ ions, leaving OH⁻ ions in medium, and make medium basic

blocks.prompt:
26 Why does ice float on water? How does this protect aquatic life?
(Barf paani par kyun tairti hai? Yeh aabi zindagi ko kaise bachati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani 4 °C par sab se ghana hai. 0 °C par hydrogen bonding molecules ko maae paani se zyada door rakhti hai, is liye barf halki hai aur tairti hai. Tairti barf insulator ban kar neeche ke paani se heat nikalne nahi deti aur aabi jaandaar bach jate hain.

book_ref.quote: When temperature falls to 0°C, water freezes but the resulting ice is less dense than liquid water

blocks.prompt:
27 Why are carbohydrates called 'hydrated carbon'?
(Carbohydrates ko 'hydrated carbon' kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates photosynthesis ki bunyaadi paidawar hain. CO₂ ki reduction se bane carbohydrate mein carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen 1:2:1 ki nisbat mein hain, yani carbon ke saath paani (H₂O) ki nisbat, is liye lafz ka matlab 'hydrated carbon' hai.

book_ref.quote: During photosynthesis, when reduction of CO₂ occurs

blocks.prompt:
28 What are monosaccharides? On what basis are they classified into subgroups?
(Monosaccharides kya hain? Inhein subgroups mein kis buniyad par baanta jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Monosaccharides aik sugar molecule wali saada sugars hain; paani mein asaani se hal hoti hain aur 3-7 carbon rakhti hain. Inhein carbon atoms ki tadaad par baanta jata hai: trioses, tetroses, pentoses, hexoses aur heptoses.

book_ref.quote: They are further classified into subgroups on the basis of number of carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
29 Give the formula and two examples of hexoses.
(Hexoses ka formula aur do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Hexoses mein 6 carbon atoms hain; formula C₆H₁₂O₆. Misalein: glucose, fructose (aur galactose). Hexoses energy store karne mein markazi kirdar ada karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Pentoses and hexoses are most common and found in all living organisms

blocks.prompt:
30 Differentiate between the isomerism of glucose with fructose and of glucose with galactose.
(Glucose aur fructose ki isomerism aur glucose aur galactose ki isomerism mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Teeno ka molecular formula C₆H₁₂O₆ aik hai magar tarteeb mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: In other words, glucose and fructose are structural isomers

rows: Fructose mein double-bonded oxygen andar ke carbon no. 2 par hai, aakhri par nahi
Carbon no. 4 par aik OH group ka rukh mukhtalif hai

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Structural isomer mein atoms ki tarteeb (kaun kis se jura) badalti hai; stereoisomer mein jor wahi rehte hain sirf aik group ka rukh (upar ya neeche) badalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
31 Name three pentose sugars and give the role of each.
(Teen pentose sugars ke naam aur un ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ribose aur deoxyribose nucleic acids aur ATP mein hain; ribulose photosynthesis mein precursor hai.

book_ref.quote: Common five-carbon or pentose sugars include ribose and deoxyribose

blocks.prompt:
32 How do monosaccharides form ring structures? Differentiate between pyran and furan rings.
(Monosaccharides ring kaise banate hain? Pyran aur furan ring mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mehlool mein zyada tar monosaccharides ring banate hain jab aik hi sugar molecule ke do carbons ke darmiyan oxygen-bridge banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Ring formation occurs when an oxygen-bridge develops between two carbon atoms of the same sugar molecule

rows: Glucose aur galactose mein C-1 aur C-5 ke darmiyan bridge
Fructose mein C-2 aur C-5, ribose mein C-1 aur C-4 ke darmiyan bridge

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between alpha-D-glucose and beta-D-glucose.
(Alpha-D-glucose aur beta-D-glucose mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh D-glucose ki do shaklein hain jo sirf carbon 1 par OH group ki simt mein mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: They differ only in the direction of OH groups on carbon 1

rows: Carbon 1 par OH neeche ki taraf
Carbon 1 par OH upar ki taraf
Bohat se jur kar starch banate hain (glycogen mein bhi)
Bohat se jur kar cellulose banate hain

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between Fischer and Haworth projections.
(Fischer aur Haworth projections mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono sugar molecules ki banawat dikhane ke tareeqe hain.

book_ref.quote: The Haworth projection is named after British chemist Sir Norman Haworth

rows: German chemist Emil Fischer ne banaya (1891)
British chemist Sir Norman Haworth ke naam par
Sugar ko khuli zanjeer ki shakal mein dikhata hai
Sugar ko ring ki shakal mein dikhata hai

blocks.prompt:
35 What are disaccharides? How do they differ from monosaccharides in solubility?
(Disaccharides kya hain? Solubility mein yeh monosaccharides se kaise mukhtalif hain?)
blocks.explanation: Disaccharides do monosaccharides se dehydration synthesis se bante hain jo glycosidic bond se jure hain; hydrolysis par apne monosaccharides dete hain. Yeh monosaccharides se kam hal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: As compared to monosaccharides, they are less soluble in water

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between maltose and lactose.
(Maltose aur lactose mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono physiologically ahem disaccharides hain.

book_ref.quote: The glucose molecules are attached by 1,4-glycosidic bond

rows: Aik glucose aur aik galactose (galactose 1-4 glucose)
Anaajon (gandum, makai) mein; starch ke hazme mein banta hai
Sirf mammals ke doodh mein; bachon ki energy ka bara zariya

blocks.prompt:
37 Why is sucrose called a transport disaccharide? Write its correct formula.
(Sucrose ko transport disaccharide kyun kehte hain? Is ka sahi formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sucrose (table sugar, glucose 1-2 fructose) bare paudon ke phloem mein hai jahan yeh paude ke hisson mein glucose le jane wala transport product hai. Formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ (glucose + fructose − H₂O).

book_ref.quote: It is the most familiar disaccharide and is also known as table sugar

blocks.prompt:
38 What is high-fructose corn syrup? Why did it replace sucrose in many foods?
(High-fructose corn syrup kya hai? Is ne bohat si ghizaon mein sucrose ki jagah kyun li?)
blocks.explanation: 1980s mein makai ke starch se mila glucose us ke isomer fructose mein badla gaya; yeh high-fructose corn syrup hai. Fructose sucrose se bhi meetha hai (glucose sirf aadha meetha) aur syrup sasta hai, is liye is ne sucrose ki jagah li, jaise cola mein.

book_ref.quote: The resulting high-fructose corn syrup is inexpensive

blocks.prompt:
39 Why is starch a suitable storage polysaccharide for plants?
(Starch paudon ke liye munasib zakheera polysaccharide kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Starch hal nahi hota aur plant cells mein daane (granules) banata hai. Hal na hone ki wajah se cells ka water potential nahi badalta, is liye cells osmosis se paani nahi lete.

book_ref.quote: Starch is the plant storage polysaccharide

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between amylose and amylopectin.
(Amylose aur amylopectin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Starch amylose aur amylopectin ka mixture hai; dono amylase se maltose mein toot-te hain, mukhtalif raftaar se.

book_ref.quote: Amylose is a chain made of glucose monomers (with 1,4-glycosidic linkages)

rows: 1,4 linkages aur 1,6 linkages ki shaakhon wali glucose zanjeer
Seedhi aur be-shaakh; helix mein lipat-ti hai
Zyada sire, amylase se jaldi toot-ti hai

blocks.prompt:
41 Differentiate between starch and glycogen.
(Starch aur glycogen mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono alpha-glucose ke zakheera polysaccharides hain.

book_ref.quote: It is similar in structure to amylopectin

rows: Plant cells mein starch granules banata hai
Zyada tar muscles aur liver mein
Bohat jaldi glucose mein toot-ta hai

blocks.prompt:
42 Differentiate between starch and cellulose.
(Starch aur cellulose mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono 1,4-glycosidic linkages wali glucose zanjeerein hain magar glucose ke mukhtalif isomers ki.

book_ref.quote: This means that in cellulose, alternate glucose molecules are inverted

rows: Beta-glucose (C-1 par OH upar); har doosra glucose ulta
Alpha 1-4 polymer lipat kar granules banata hai
Beta 1-4 polymer seedhi zanjeerein jo microfibrils banati hain
Plant cell wall ka bara hissa; mazbooti deta hai
Amylase se nahi toot-ta; cellulase chahiye

blocks.prompt:
43 How does cellulose give strength to plant cells?
(Cellulose plant cells ko mazbooti kaise deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose ka beta 1-4 glucose polymer seedhi zanjeerein banata hai. Saikron zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se jur kar microfibrils aur phir cellulose fibrils banati hain. Yeh bohat mazboot aur sakht hain aur plant cells, chhote paudon aur kaghaz aur cotton ko mazbooti dete hain.

book_ref.quote: These microfibrils make cellulose fibrils

blocks.prompt:
44 How do cows and termites digest cellulose though they live mainly on it?
(Gaaye aur deemak cellulose kaise hazam karte hain jab ke un ki ghiza zyada tar yahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose ka beta-glycosidic bond amylase se nahi toot-ta; is ke liye cellulase enzyme chahiye. Gaaye aur deemak jaise herbivores ki aanton mein mutualistic (bahami faide wale) bacteria hain jo un ka cellulose hazam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Herbivore animals, like cows and termites whose diet is mainly cellulose

blocks.prompt:
45 What is chitin? Where is it found?
(Chitin kya hai? Yeh kahan paya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chitin cellulose ki badli hui shakal hai: cellulose jaisi linkage wala glucose polymer, magar har glucose mein nitrogen wala group shamil hai. Yeh kekron, lobsters aur keeron ke bairooni dhanche aur fungi ki cell wall mein hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a modified form of cellulose

blocks.prompt:
46 Write the source and two uses of agar.
(Agar ka maakhaz aur do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar red algae ki cell walls mein hota hai. Yeh ghiza gaarhi karne aur labs mein bacteria aur fungi ugane ke medium ke taur par istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used as a thickener in foods

blocks.prompt:
47 Name polysaccharides used as building material in cell walls and give where each is found.
(Cell walls mein tameeri maadde ke taur par istemal hone wale polysaccharides ke naam aur jagah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose: plant cell walls. Pectin aur lignin: plant cells ki cell walls. Chitin: fungi ki cell wall. Agar: red algae ki cell walls. Murein (sugar-peptide polymer): prokaryotes ki cell walls.

book_ref.quote: They are also the polysaccharides used as building material

blocks.prompt:
48 Why are proteins called the principal compounds or building blocks of life?
(Proteins ko zindagi ke bunyaadi compounds ya building blocks kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Proteins cell mein sab se zyada organic compounds hain. Yeh cells aur jaandaaron ki banawat ke liye ahem hain aur un ke har kaam mein shamil hain. Naam (Greek 'Proteios', pehle darje ke molecules) Berzelius ne 1838 mein isi ahmiyat ke liye rakha.

book_ref.quote: In this way, they act as the building blocks of life

blocks.prompt:
49 What is an amino acid? Name the four groups attached to its alpha carbon.
(Amino acid kya hai? Is ke alpha carbon se jure chaar groups ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Amino acid proteins ka bunyaadi unit hai: aisa organic molecule jis mein aik hi carbon (alpha carbon) se chaar groups jure hain: amino group (NH₂), carboxyl group (COOH), hydrogen (H) aur side group (R).

book_ref.quote: Amino acid is the basic structural unit of proteins

blocks.prompt:
50 What determines the identity of an amino acid? Give two examples.
(Amino acid ki pehchaan kis se tay hoti hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Har amino acid ki pehchaan aur khaas chemical khasoosiyat us ke side group (R) se tay hoti hai jo alpha carbon se covalent bond se jura hai. Glycine mein R hydrogen atom aur alanine mein CH₃ hai.

book_ref.quote: The identity and unique chemical properties of each amino acid are determined by the nature of its side group (R)

blocks.prompt:
51 Differentiate between essential and non-essential amino acids.
(Essential aur non-essential amino acids mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar proteins 20 qisam ke amino acids se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: These are called non-essential amino acids

rows: Jism nahi bana sakta; ghiza se lene parte hain
Misalein: lysine, leucine, valine, tryptophan (histidine sirf bachon ke liye)

blocks.prompt:
52 How does a dipeptide grow into a polypeptide chain?
(Dipeptide polypeptide chain mein kaise barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dipeptide ke aik sire par amino group aur doosre par carboxyl group hota hai, is liye dono sire mazeed peptide bonds ke liye dastyab hain. Mazeed amino acids jurne se aakhir polypeptide chain banti hai.

book_ref.quote: So, both reactive parts are available for further peptide bonds

blocks.prompt:
53 How many polypeptide chains do insulin and haemoglobin have? What decides the shape of a chain?
(Insulin aur haemoglobin mein kitni polypeptide chains hain? Chain ki shakal kis se tay hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Protein mein aik ya zyada polypeptide chains hoti hain: insulin mein do aur haemoglobin mein chaar. Chains ki shakal amino acids ki tadaad, qisam aur tarteeb par hai, jis se proteins ke structure ke darje bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Polypeptide chains assume different shapes on the basis of number, types and sequence of amino acids

blocks.prompt:
54 On what two bases can proteins be classified? Name the classes in each.
(Proteins ko kin do buniyadon par baanta ja sakta hai? Har aik ki qismein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jaandaar mein kaam ki buniyad par: structural aur functional proteins. Structure ki buniyad par (tajveez-shuda): fibrous aur globular proteins.

book_ref.quote: on the basis of their role in living organisms, these are “structural proteins” and “functional proteins”

blocks.prompt:
55 Differentiate between fibrous and globular proteins.
(Fibrous aur globular proteins mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.4 proteins ki do structural qismon ka muqabla karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Do not disorganize easily

rows: Crystal ban sakte hain; salt, acid, base mehlool aur aqueous alcohol mein hal
Mahaul ki tabdeeli se be-tarteeb ho jate hain
Misalein: keratin, collagen, fibrin, actin, silk
Misalein: enzymes, antibodies, kuch hormones, haemoglobin

blocks.prompt:
56 Give the role of proteins in plasma membranes.
(Plasma membranes mein proteins ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Proteins tamam plasma membranes ka ahem hissa hain. Channel proteins cells mein maadde ki aamad-o-raft control karte hain, jaise neurons ka sodium-potassium pump proteins se bana hai jo nerve cell mein Na⁺ aur K⁺ ki aamad-o-raft control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This pump controls the movement of Na⁺ and K⁺ ions in and out of nerve cell

blocks.prompt:
57 Name two transport proteins of the body and what each carries.
(Jism ke do transport proteins ke naam aur un ka le jaya jane wala maadda likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Haemoglobin aur myoglobin O₂ aur kuch CO₂ le jate hain. Cytochromes electron transport chain mein electrons le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Some globular proteins work to transport different materials throughout the body

blocks.prompt:
58 How do proteins help in blood clotting?
(Proteins khoon jamne mein kaise madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khoon ka jamna zakhm ke baad khoon behne se rokta hai. Khoon mein fibrinogen protein hota hai; zakhm par yeh fibrin mein badalta hai jo reshe banata hai aur lothra ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The fibrin makes fibres and a clot is formed

blocks.prompt:
59 What are antibodies? Write their function.
(Antibodies kya hain? In ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Antibodies ahem (globular) proteins hain. Yeh bairooni maaddon (antigens) ko pehchan kar un se jurte hain aur unhein be-zarar bana dete hain.

book_ref.quote: They recognize and combine with foreign substances (antigens) and convert them into harmless products

blocks.prompt:
60 What are ion-binding proteins? Give two examples.
(Ion-binding proteins kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Ion-binding proteins jism ke mukhtalif hisson mein ions jama karte hain. Ferritin cell ke andar iron jama karne wala bara protein hai; casein doodh ka protein hai jo potassium aur calcium ions jama karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Some ion-binding proteins store ions in different parts of body

blocks.prompt:
61 Why are blood ferritin levels measured in patients?
(Mareezon mein khoon ki ferritin kyun naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ferritin ki miqdaar anaemia ki tashkhees ka zariya hai. Zyada ferritin ka matlab iron ki ziyadti; kam ferritin ka matlab iron ki kami ka khatra jo der saver anaemia bana sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Blood ferritin levels are measured in patients as a diagnostic tool of anaemia

blocks.prompt:
62 What are repressors?
(Repressors kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Repressors woh proteins hain jo RNA ki tayyari rok kar gene ke amal ko control karte hain. Yeh genes ko zaroorat ki jagah aur waqt par kaam karne dete hain.

book_ref.quote: These proteins allow genes to work where and when required

blocks.prompt:
63 Define primary structure of a protein, with the example of insulin.
(Insulin ki misaal se protein ke primary structure ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Primary structure amino acids ki seedhi tarteeb hai: polypeptide chain mein amino acids ki tadaad aur tarteeb. Insulin mein do chains hain: chhoti alpha chain 21 aur lambi beta chain 30 amino acids ki.

book_ref.quote: All protein molecules (whether simple or complex) have specific primary structures

blocks.prompt:
64 What change in haemoglobin causes sickle cell anaemia, and what is its effect?
(Haemoglobin mein kaun si tabdeeli sickle cell anaemia paida karti hai aur is ka asar kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har beta chain ki chhati jagah par sirf aik amino acid ki ghalti: glutamic acid ki jagah valine. Red blood cells darranti numa ho jate hain aur ghair-maamooli haemoglobin kaafi oxygen nahi le ja sakta.

book_ref.quote: Due to sickle cell haemoglobin, red blood cells get sickle shapes

blocks.prompt:
65 Differentiate between alpha helix and pleated sheet.
(Alpha helix aur pleated sheet mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono proteins ke secondary structures hain jo qareebi amino acids ke amino aur carboxyl groups ke hydrogen bonds se qaim hain.

book_ref.quote: Both these structures are maintained by hydrogen bonds between amino and carboxyl groups of nearby amino acids

rows: Polypeptide chain ke tah hone se
Tah ki hui sheet ki shakal

blocks.prompt:
66 How do hydrophobic and hydrophilic interactions give a stable tertiary structure?
(Hydrophobic aur hydrophilic interactions mustahkam tertiary structure kaise dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chain ke amino acids paani se interact karte hain. Hydrophobic (non-polar) amino acids paani ki hydrogen bonding kharab karte hain is liye andar chhup jate hain, aur hydrophilic (polar) amino acids bahar paani ki taraf, jis se sab se mustahkam globular shakal banti hai.

book_ref.quote: At the same time the hydrophilic (polar) amino acids turn out, towards the surface of water

blocks.prompt:
67 Differentiate between tertiary and quaternary structure of proteins.
(Proteins ke tertiary aur quaternary structure mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono protein structure ke unche darje hain.

book_ref.quote: When two or more polypeptide chains with tertiary structures are held together

rows: Aik chain ka secondary structure mur kar pecheeda globular shakal banata hai
Tertiary structure wali do ya zyada chains ikatthi hoti hain
Ionic, hydrogen aur disulphide bonds se qaim
Hydrophobic interactions, hydrogen aur ionic bonds se qaim

blocks.prompt:
68 What are lipids? Name their classes.
(Lipids kya hain? In ki qismein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Lipids non-polar molecules ka group hain jo paani mein hal nahi magar organic solvents (ether, alcohol) mein hal hote hain. Qismein: acylglycerols, waxes, phospholipids, terpenes, steroids aur prostaglandins.

book_ref.quote: They are a diverse group of molecules and are classified as acylglycerols

blocks.prompt:
69 Differentiate between fats and oils.
(Fats aur oils mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono acylglycerols (glycerol + fatty acids) hain.

book_ref.quote: The acylglycerols which are solid at room temperature, are called fats

rows: Paudon ke zyada tar acylglycerols (moongphali, makai, castor oil)
Saturated fatty acids, zyada C-H bonds, zyada energy
Unsaturated fatty acids, kam C-H bonds

blocks.prompt:
70 What is an ester? Which parts form the water released in making an acylglycerol?
(Ester kya hai? Acylglycerol bante waqt nikalne wala paani kin hisson se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ester alcohol aur acid ke reaction se banne wala compound hai jis mein paani ka molecule nikalta hai. Acylglycerols fatty acids aur glycerol ke esters hain: OH acid ke carboxyl (-COOH) group se aur H alcohol ke -OH group se aata hai.

book_ref.quote: An ester is the compound produced as the result of a chemical reaction of an alcohol with an acid

blocks.prompt:
71 Differentiate between saturated and unsaturated fatty acids.
(Saturated aur unsaturated fatty acids mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono carboxyl group par khatam hone wali lambi hydrocarbon zanjeerein hain.

book_ref.quote: In saturated fatty acids, all internal carbon atoms possess hydrogen side-groups

rows: Zanjeer mein koi double bond nahi
Aik ya zyada carbon joron mein double bonds (zyada se zyada 6)
Andar ke tamam carbons par hydrogen
Zyada se zyada mumkin se kam hydrogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
72 Why are acylglycerols efficient energy-storage molecules?
(Acylglycerols energy store karne ke liye behtareen molecules kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: In mein C-H bonds zyada hain is liye zyada energy store hoti hai. Non-polar hone se yeh hal nahi hote aur jism mein khaas jagahon par jama kiye ja sakte hain. Is liye jaandaar lambe arse ke liye glucose ko fats ya oils mein badal dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Acylglycerols are efficient energy-storage molecules

blocks.prompt:
73 What is a phospholipid? Describe its head and tail.
(Phospholipid kya hai? Is ke sir aur dum ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Phospholipid phosphatidic acid (glycerol + do fatty acids + phosphate) ka derivative hai jis ke phosphate par nitrogenous base (choline, ethanolamine ya serine) jura hai. Is ka sir polar (nitrogenous base aur phosphate) aur dum non-polar (do fatty acids) hai.

book_ref.quote: Phospholipids play important structural roles in making plasma membranes

blocks.prompt:
74 What are prostaglandins? Give their roles.
(Prostaglandins kya hain? In ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Prostaglandins badle hue fatty acids wale lipids hain jin ki non-polar dumein paanch carbon ring se juri hain. Vertebrates ke tissues mein yeh maqami chemical paigham-bar hain: kuch smooth muscles sukarte aur dheele karte hain, kuch khoon ki naaliyon ko tang ya khula karte hain, aur infection par sozish mein shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: They are also involved in inflammatory response to infection

blocks.prompt:
75 Write four roles of lipids in life.
(Zindagi mein lipids ke chaar kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Lipids sab se zyada energy wale ghizai ajza hain (1 g se 9.5 kcal); yeh tamam cell membranes ka lazmi hissa hain; vitamins A, D, E aur K le jate hain; ahem aaza ko gaddi (cushion) dete hain aur jild ke neeche charbi jism ko hiddat se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: Lipids play a role as a mechanical cushion/support for vital body organs

blocks.prompt:
76 Give the importance of cholesterol.
(Cholesterol ki ahmiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cholesterol, janwaron ki cell membranes ka aam steroid, membranes qaim rakhta hai aur lipids ki muntaqili mein madad deta hai. Yeh vitamin D, bile acids aur steroid hormones (androgens, oestrogens), adrenal hormones aur corticosteroids ka precursor hai.

book_ref.quote: cholesterol is involved in the maintenance of membranes

blocks.prompt:
77 What are anabolic steroids? Why are they banned?
(Anabolic steroids kya hain? Yeh mamnoo kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Anabolic steroids banaye gaye steroids hain jo testosterone jaise hain; yeh muscle aur haddi ka wazan barhate hain. Kuch khiladiyon ne jaldi muscles banane ke liye inhein istemal kiya. Yeh mamnoo hain kyun ke sakht jismani aur zehni masail dete hain, jaise gehra depression aur liver ka nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: Today, anabolic steroids are banned

blocks.prompt:
78 What are terpenes? Give examples.
(Terpenes kya hain? Misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Terpenes lipids ka bohat bara aur mukhtalif group hain jo isoprene units (CH₂=C(CH₃)−CH=CH₂) se bante hain. Yeh paudon mein chlorophyll aur aankhon mein retinal pigments banate hain; vitamin A aur rubber bhi terpenes hain.

book_ref.quote: Terpenes form many biologically important pigments

blocks.prompt:
79 Write the composition of waxes and two of their uses.
(Waxes ki banawat aur in ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Waxes ki koi tay-shuda banawat nahi; yeh lambe alkanes (taaq tadaad, 25-35 C), glycerol ke ilawa alcohols, ketones aur lambe fatty acids ka mixture hain. Istemal: kaghaz aur card ko waterproof karna, furniture, joote aur gaariyon ki polish, mombattiyan, crayons aur rangeen pencils.

book_ref.quote: Waxes are used to waterproof paper and cards

blocks.prompt:
80 Differentiate between purine and pyrimidine bases.
(Purine aur pyrimidine bases mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh nucleic acids ke nitrogenous bases ki do qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: There are two types of nitrogenous bases in nucleic acids

rows: Cytosine (DNA aur RNA), thymine (sirf DNA), uracil (sirf RNA)
Adenine aur guanine (DNA aur RNA dono)

blocks.prompt:
81 Differentiate between ribonucleotides and deoxyribonucleotides.
(Ribonucleotides aur deoxyribonucleotides mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleotides apne nitrogenous base ke naam par hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The nucleotides of RNA are known as ribonucleotides and those of DNA are known as deoxyribonucleotides

blocks.prompt:
82 Why is ATP called the energy currency of the cell?
(ATP ko cell ki energy currency kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: ATP adenine ka triphosphate nucleotide hai: aik ribose par teen phosphate groups. Yeh apne do phosphate groups aik aik kar ke alag kar ke ADP aur phir AMP banta hai aur cell ko energy deta hai.

book_ref.quote: You know that ATP is the “energy currency” of cell

blocks.prompt:
83 What is a polynucleotide chain? Which of its ends are free?
(Polynucleotide chain kya hai? Is ke kaun se sire azad hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleotides phosphodiester linkages se jur kar lambi polynucleotide chains banate hain. 5' sire ka phosphate group aur 3' sire ka OH group hamesha azad hote hain. RNA mein aik aisi chain aur DNA mein do hain.

book_ref.quote: RNA is made of a single polynucleotide chain

blocks.prompt:
84 Compare the DNA double helix with a ladder.
(DNA double helix ka seerhi se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: DNA ki do strands lipat kar double helix banati hain jo seerhi jaisa hai: is ke pole sugars aur phosphate groups ke hain aur dande nitrogenous base pairs hain, har aik aik purine aur aik pyrimidine ka, jo kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure hain.

book_ref.quote: The double helix is like a ladder

blocks.prompt:
85 Which bases pair in DNA, and how many hydrogen bonds join each pair?
(DNA mein kaun se bases jor banate hain aur har jor mein kitne hydrogen bonds hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik strand ka adenine doosri strand ke thymine se (do hydrogen bonds) aur guanine cytosine se (teen hydrogen bonds) jurta hai, ya iske ulat.

book_ref.quote: There are two hydrogen bonds between A and T pair

blocks.prompt:
86 Where is DNA located in eukaryotes, prokaryotes and viruses?
(Eukaryotes, prokaryotes aur viruses mein DNA kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotes: nucleus ke andar chromosomes ka hissa (taqreeban 2% mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein). Prokaryotes: cytoplasm mein (waazeh nucleus nahi). Viruses: protein coat se dhaka core molecule.

book_ref.quote: In viruses, DNA is located as a core molecule, covered by a protein coat

blocks.prompt:
87 What is a gene? How does DNA control the activities of a cell?
(Gene kya hai? DNA cell ki sargarmiyan kaise control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene DNA nucleotides ki tarteeb hai jo polypeptide ka code hai; DNA ka 'program' genes ki shakal mein hai. Gene ON hone par us ki tarteeb RNA mein transcribe aur khaas proteins mein translate hoti hai; yun DNA cell ki khasoosiyat aur sargarmiyan control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: DNA contains the “program” that ultimately directs all cellular activities

blocks.prompt:
88 Write the structure and function of messenger RNA.
(Messenger RNA ki banawat aur kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: mRNA ribonucleotides ki aik strand hai jis ki tarteeb DNA ki aik strand ke complementary (mutabiq) hai; yeh kul RNA ka taqreeban 3-4% hai. Yeh DNA ka genetic paigham ribosomes tak le jata hai taake khaas protein bane.

book_ref.quote: It carries the genetic message of DNA to ribosomes to form particular protein

blocks.prompt:
89 Differentiate between tRNA and rRNA.
(tRNA aur rRNA mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono tamam zinda cells mein paye jane wale RNA ki qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: tRNAs transport amino acids to ribosome and mRNA, in the process of protein synthesis

rows: Nisbatan chhota, helical, clover ke patte jaisa
Nucleoli ke DNA se banta hai; ribosomal protein se jur kar ribosomes banata hai
Amino acids ribosome aur mRNA tak le jata hai
Ribosomes mein protein synthesis ki machinery

blocks.prompt:
90 Differentiate between transcription and translation.
(Transcription aur translation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh central dogma ke do qadam hain, genes parhne aur zahir karne ka mushtarka tareeqa.

book_ref.quote: All organisms use the same basic mechanism of reading and expressing genes

rows: Gene ki RNA copy banti hai
RNA ki maloomat protein banne ki rehnumai karti hai

blocks.prompt:
91 Differentiate between glycolipids and glycoproteins.
(Glycolipids aur glycoproteins mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono carbohydrate wale conjugated molecules hain.

book_ref.quote: They are an integral structural component of membranes

rows: Lipid aur carbohydrate ka covalent jor
Protein aur carbohydrate polymer ka covalent jor
Membranes, khoon ke serum, cell ki ratoobaton, cartilage, aankh, jild mein

blocks.prompt:
92 Differentiate between lipoproteins and nucleoproteins.
(Lipoproteins aur nucleoproteins mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono protein wale conjugated molecules hain.

book_ref.quote: Lipoproteins are the basic structural framework of all types of plasma membranes

rows: Lipids aur proteins hydrophobic interactions se jure
Chromosomal DNA aur proteins ionic bonds se jure
Plasma membranes ka bunyaadi dhancha; khoon mein lipids le jate hain (very low-density lipoproteins)
Histones DNA se nucleosomes banate hain; chromosomes ko mustahkam aur gene expression control karte hain
